notes.title: New Steam Trading Cards and Game Update Live!
notes.content:
Greetings Savages!For over a month our forges here at Last Bastion Studios have been focused on hammering out new stuff for the game. With this release Savage Landers now have access to Steam Trading Cards, updated content, bug fixes and balance tweaks. This release is one of many in our continued efforts to provide players with a more rich and fun survival experience. More info below!

Steam Trading CardsLong overdue, but well worth the wait. Players and fans will find this Savage Trading Card bundle complete with badges, emoticons, and profile backgrounds that capture the spirit of the game!

How do you get them? Random card drops occur over time while playing Savage Lands and if you are super lucky, card drops will be of the special foil variety. Foil cards are quite rare and very valuable to collectors and fans alike.

Be sure to check out the Steam Trading Marketplace to see what sort of other unique inventory items members of the Steam Community might offer for any of the trading cards.

Trading Cards Series 1 Contains:
8 trading cards
5 regular badges + 1 foil badge
3 profile backgrounds
10 emoticons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7623929/8ddef41f826c144e28bed2ca19bd4ab07c6db3cd.png
Fabled WeaponsFabled weapons and armor have made their way to the Sundered Isles of Tarvhas. These ancient relics are from a time long since passed. They were inspired by the originals found in the legacy version of the game. We have rebalanced them and added new visual FX to capture their uniqueness.

It is rumored that the dungeons of Meltok and Carta Sul hold the secrets to unlocking these powerful weapons of war.

Bug Fixes and BalanceVarious items, creatures, armor have gone through additional balance changes for playability. This process is ongoing, so please let us know what you think!

We’d like to thank our dedicated community of players for providing a continuous stream of feedback to help shape Savage Lands into the game that it is today. 

For a full list of tweaks/changes please follow the link below. Returning players there are some important details in the patch notes we recommend you read before launching into your world.

PATCH NOTES: https://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/1/1640915206442322063/

Be well and Stay Savage! ːSummoningStoneː

Greetings Savages!

Last Bastion is pleased to announce the release of our latest Game Update (Build 71). As many of you know over the last several months we've spent a lot of time building out new content, updating lore, fixing bugs and balancing items/creatures to provide a much more rich and deeper experience. 

If you are returning to the Savage Lands or new to the world of Tarvhas, what can you expect to see from the last several updates you ask?

New Content
Adventurers must travel beyond the shores of Freydalyn to the rediscovered land of Oscira; embarking on an epic journey while exploring places and facing enemies unseen. Only the mightiest of warriors will prevail in this hostile and perilous land.

A new threat has appeared on the island of Snowmere. The gates of Meltok have opened and the Undead now seem to roam unchecked looking for flesh to feast on. Find out who or what is behind these vile creatures now plaguing the land.

AI Improvements
Tweaks have been done so that combat feels more fluid and balance between creature damage and armor mitigation makes sense for the area of difficulty you are in. Creatures should also path a bit more smoothly around obstacles.

Player Progression and Item Balance
Some items and armor have gone through additional balance changes to better fit the progression we envision for the game. This process has been ongoing and is now close to complete. Let us know what you think!

We’d like to give a big THANK YOU to our dedicated community of players that have tested and provided feedback to help shape Savage Lands into a better game for all. You are the true heroes of Tarvhas.

For a full list of tweaks/changes please follow the link below. Returning players there are some important details in the patch notes we recommend you read before launching into your world.

PATCH NOTES: https://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/1/1640915206442322063/

We look forward to building a better game for all players!

Stay Savage!

-Euryidium

Last Bastion Studios is pleased to announce the release of our latest Game Update (Build 30). Over the last month we've spent a lot of time rebalancing the later areas of the game to create a much more rich and unique experience. This work will tie into additional content plans we have for the future, so it was imperative we got these foundational changes out of the way.

There is still much work to do, but thanks to our dedicated community of players we have managed to reshape/balance/tune the game at an accelerated pace.

We look forward to building a better game for all players!

As always, Stay Savage!

-Last Bastion Studios

IMPORTANT: World Update
Due to the vast number of changes to the terrain and objects across all the islands done in Build 24, we are recommending existing players returning to the game from prior releases create new worlds. Because of all these changes, we cannot guarantee the integrity of your world saves prior to this update. Existing characters are fine to use.

If you are new to the game, this does not apply.

IMPORTANT: Video Settings Update
FOR THIS BUILD we do recommend EXISTING players take the following steps to refresh their video settings:
Go into Options
Click Settings
Click Default
Click Apply

Once this is done please adjust the options as you see fit. This will clean out any residual data from previous builds. We do apologize for the inconvenience.

 Build 30 Changes 
Improvements and changes that you can expect to see in this build:

Major Bug Fix: Resolved rare crash with skeleton spawn in Carta Sul
Major Bug Fix: Addressed several areas in the world where the player could get stuck
Bug Fix: Copper Armor now displays correct material
Bug Fix: Devourer Armor now displays white fur on player when worn
Bug Fix: Iron Nodes now use correct texture
Bug Fix: Improved performance around portals
Content: Heart of Tarvhas now required to summon Kur
Content: Additional Spirit creatures added to the world (Furies, Tortured skeletons)
Balance: All spirit based creatures now deal Spirit attack damage which bypasses damage mitigation stats on armor
Content: Lycor now roams the Ruins of Ketta Zah on Jormughr
Content: Kiffi changed to spirit and now roams Carta Sul
Content: Elite Furies added to the Ruins of Ketta Zah on Jormughr
Content: Spirit Armor line added to the game, mitigates damage from Spirit based creatures
Content: Labels have been added to various items for better sorting in the crafting UI
Content: Crystalline Armor renamed to Crystalline Spirit Armor; requirements to craft have changed
Content: Hal Potion descriptions updated
Balance: Kur health reduced by 10%
Balance: Kur tail whip now has a chance to disease
Balance:  Forest Giants have been revamped and rebalanced
Balance: Creatures now have a chance to drop no loot
Balance: Kiilot no longer spawn on Freydalyn
Balance: Kiilot health increased by 50%
Balance: Iron Armor and weapons removed from Crafting list
Balance: Iron Armor now drop only from creatures
Balance: Steel Ingots now require Iron ore instead of Iron Ingots to craft
Balance: Tin through Steel armor/weapons repair requirements have changed; now requires Basic Forge
Balance: Steel Armor requirements have changed
Balance: Copper through Silver armor balance has changed
Balance: Hardened Leather Armor is no longer craftable; drop only now
Balance: Savage Fur Armor damage mitigation increased by 15%
Balance: Savage Fur Armor heat mitigation increased by 50%
Balance: Savage Fur Armor crafting requirements updated
Balance: Devourer Armor crafting requirements updated
Balance: Devourer Armor heat mitigation increased by 50%

Balance: Mithras no longer required to craft Silver armor
Balance: Mithras now protects against Spirit damage and disease

Known Issues

notes.title: New Savage Lands Game Update (Build 9) Live!
notes.content:
Hello Savages!

Last Bastion Studios is pleased to announce the release of our latest Game Update (Build 9) to the public. The LBS team has spent 3 months working on tons of fixes, tweaks, and balance changes to make a better game for you the players. Much of the work that went into this update was at the request of the community along with things we felt would help make a better game. The LBS team also tuned up the art giving the Savage Lands a much ominous look and feel. There is still more work to do and we look forward to your feedback.

Below is a high level overview of what to expect. For more detailed information and a full list of changes please visit our forums.

Art Changes
New Colors, the Rebirth of the Savage Lands: Over the last several months Last Bastion spent a lot of time reviewing the old art style found in 422. Our conclusion was that the current implementation with its smoggy atmosphere, dirty/muddy snow, and color palette simply did not sell a world that was frozen by bitter cold and battle worn by war. So we did a lot of research. We studied the landscapes, skies, snow and fauna of real world locations and then applied those color palettes to the game. With our most recent update, we've re-envisioned colors, lightning and general atmosphere to give the game a fresh new look and tell a stronger visual narrative about the soul of Savage Lands.

AI Updates
Work has continued across the AI systems. Creature attack ranges have been further adjusted to reduce damage from long distances, pathing around objects have been tuned, and spawners rebalanced. 

Player Progression and Item Balance
This update will change the crafting experience. Some items and armor have gone through balance changes to better fit the progression we envision for the game. This is an ongoing process and will take multiple updates before it is complete

Thanks again for all the support!

Stay Savage!
Last Bastion Studios

notes.content:

New Features & Patch Notes: 
AI Updates  have hit the islands. While there are still changes to come to spawners, pathing, and AI, these updates should allow to continue to happily slaughter the creatures that scamper about the lands. If you see something that doesn’t look right, please give us some feedback!

 Crash Fixes  have been and will continue to be a priority with every update. Keep posting in the forums when you have a crash. It always helps if you have a good solid way to reproduce it!

notes.content:
WARNING

 Big Changes: 
Buildings Overhaul, New Traps, More Lore, and More Performance Updates!

New Features & Patch Notes: 
 Buildings Have Been Overhauled!  Here is a rundown of everything that is changing for them in this update:
 There are 8 new buildings that can be crafted by the player. They are the Stone Shed, Stone Hut, Stone Bunker, Keep, Barracks, Stone Cabin, Gathering Hall, and Stone Lodge.
 All wooden buildings are now burnable. Be careful not to get caught inside once things heat up, or you may be in for a world of hurt! 
 All damaged buildings that pre-existed on the islands and were not player built are not repairable or destroyable. 
 Due to the overhaul of our building system, some players may encounter issues with pre-update saves and new buildings overlapping older, player-built structures. This issue can be fixed by simply destroying the overlapping offenders. The good news is that you will get some extra resources for your efforts!
There are specific resistances for the buildings depending on what they are made out of. Wood buildings now are meant to be chopped down with axes and stone buildings demolished with hammers.
 All of the buildings have had a design pass on their health!
 All buildings have more refined damage states! 

 More Lore has been added to the game! Now providing twice as much history to the island and its inhabitants! Players can now find various personal and historical accounts that may aid in their quest for survival. These entries may also provide some insight into events that led to the islands’ downfall and change, as well as clues how past exiles may have originally ended up there.

Two New Traps have been added to the game! These traps are the Tension Coil Skewer Trap and the Spiked Spring Trap! Both offer new ways to protect buildings that you have crafted while you are off adventuring! They may hurt a bit in PvP too!

Performance Updates are now live in the default build. We will continue to make adjustments every build to improve the experience for everybody.

New items added! Here is a list of all of the new items that have been added or adjusted:
 Tension Coil Skewer Trap – A trip wire that will unleash wooden spears in a single thrust from a tightly wound rope.
Spiked Spring Trap – Disease covered spikes that will penetrate the victim’s feet when stepped upon.
More User Feedback for Burning! We’ve added an action meter to let you know if you are actively trying to set something on fire and how long it will take until it burns. 

Art:
New icons and art added to the Journal. 
 New art added for Lore items.
New art updates for multiple buildings. 

Environment:
New art added to Freydalyn, and Jormungahr.

Collected lore now displays correctly.
A save/load trap bug has been addressed with losing the traps or crashing.
Removed the Water Quality setting and set it to high by default. You now have a water on/off option.
Unselected monikers are now more transparent for better differentiation.
All health bars now fade out instead of popping.
A fire screaming audio bug has been addressed.
The moon is now opposite of the Sun’s position in the sky making it easier to track time at night.
Various crash fixes. 

 Known Issues 
LOD issues with certain objects.
Enemies popping and not pathing correctly.

 More Performance Updates.
Item adding and balancing continues.
More art and design updates to the new world.
Bug fixes.

notes.title: Game Update #33, Build 0.8.3.132, is live!
notes.content:
WARNING 
The original Sundered Isle's content, which utilized Unity 4, has been moved to a Legacy Branch allowing players to access their old save data and continue playing the old content as they wish. Transferring save data between the Main game branch and the Legacy game branch is not supported.

 Big Changes: 
New Enemies: Trogres, Grinfels, Ghuuls, and Infernal Eks now roam the Savage world.

 New Features & Patches Notes: 
Trogres wield enormous weapons and will smash anything that crosses their path. An unaware Savage that is not prepared for this fight will be no match for these mighty foes!
Grinfels must consume silver to live. If you find one and kill it, make sure to loot it for this very precious metal.
Ghuuls  scurry and crawl from the shadows of the old towns to rip you limb from limb. 
Infernal Eks burn fiery rage when compared to their less dangerous greener siblings.

 A ‘Player Specific Item’ system is now available. This means certain items like ‘Gary’s Tattered Bag’ will be available for every player to pick up on that a server.
Torches and Dim Torches no longer provide the player with warmth.
Weapons now have piercing levels according to their type.
Silver and Gold items are now available.
Heavy Armor now has higher durability than Light Armor.
Heavy Armor now requires a Crafting Table to repair. 
Light Armor can be repaired anywhere but requires the use of a Patching Kit. Patching kits are made from Needles and Sinew.
Needles can now be crafted from Human or Animal Bones.
Chests no longer have the Loot All function.
Flawless items have been removed. They will no longer drop or be craftable. If you currently own one, they are still repairable.

Effects have been added to the volcanic vents of Jormunghar.
Hot springs can now be found in Jormunghar.
New towns have been added to Jormunghar.
New icons and art added to the Journal. 

Environment:
Water is now less lethal.
New locations added to Freydalyn, and Jormungahr.
Jormunghar now has Silver nodes available.
Cotton can now be found throughout Freydalyn. 
Buildables can now be placed in more areas.
The Monolith has returned… 

Enemies:
New animations have been added for the Skeletons, Wolves, Kiilots and Kruul.
Eldar is now named Eldair.
Furies no longer drop Worn Steel Gear, and instead drop Worn Iron Gear. 
The Forest Giants, Kruul, Chilkoot, Kur, and the Furies have had their stats rebalanced. 

 Bug Fixes: 
Fixed collision issues with portals.
Fixed crash bug that occurred upon killing Kur.
Fixed Forest Giant targeting and health resetting issues.
Fixed several visual bugs related to armor and missing armor.
Fixed the water avoidance for enemy AI. Thus ends the days of the Seadeers. Rest in peace our furred aquatic friends.
Fixed the block system so now pierced shields and armor will still properly block 40% of the damage.
Fixed the "You are no longer freezing." message that was spamming the player chat window.
Dropping an equipped secondary item should now properly update your inventory player model. 
Various crash and network issues have been addressed. 

 Known Issues 
LOD issues with certain objects.

Moving the Beta branch to the Main branch on Monday, March 14th, 2016.
Moving the original game branch to a Legacy branch on Monday, March 14th, 2016.

More art and design updates to the new world.
Bug fixes.

notes.title: Game Update #32, Build 0.8.3.109 is live only for the Beta!
notes.content:
WARNING  This update is for the Beta only. The Beta allows you to play on the Islands of Tarvhas which run on the 5.3 Unity engine. Once the content is functional, we will merge the Beta  into the default branch. The Sundered Isles will be moved to a legacy branch for those who would like to play their old saves. Thank you for your patience while we update the game weekly. 
        
 Big Changes: 
New Item: Shields!
New Enemies: The Dragon Kur. The Devourer. Eldar, Thuum, Grot, and Ket are the four guardians (Forest Giants).

 New Features & Patches Notes: 
Shields can be crafted and used! When equipped in your off hand, shields protect you from damage. Currently, shields will range from Wooden to Steel.  Shields are a great help when fighting enemies, but they do require stamina and prevent jumping.

Savages! The Dragon Kur has returned and awaits your challenge! It’s probably best to gather your friends before you take on this mighty foe! His loot drops are not yet finalized. Look for this and many other improvements to the encounter in the future.

Eldar, Thuum, Grot, and Ket are the 4 guardians of the Skulls of Power.  Find them, kill them, recover the skulls and open the portal to Jormungahr to face off against the mighty Kur.

The Devourer can now be found in The Wildwoods. Killing him yields Pelts of the Devourer which can be crafted into a set of Devourer Armor.

Kruul Spawning, Opening the Portal, and The Devourer spawning all have gold chat window text that accompanies them.

New items added! Here is a list of all of the new items that have been added or adjusted:
New icons and art.
Armor & Shield should now block Poison & Bleeding damage effects.
Shields will block 80% of damage unless pierced, continuing the 20% into Armor/Player.
Damage to armor is now spread out across all worn armor pieces instead of selecting a single random piece.
One Handed Weapons deal roughly half the damage as their Two Handed Counterparts, however they can be swung twice as fast.
Cured, and Smoked Meats have been temporarily disabled until we get their actual crafting setups working.
A large amount of new recipes have been unlocked.
Legacy weapons and armor no longer exist. 

Art:
 New Wolf and Kiilot attack animations.
New Skeleton movement and attack animations.
New Armor art for Mithras, Crystalline, Dragon Skin, Heavy Tin, Heavy Copper, Heavy Iron, Heavy Bronze and Heavy Steel.
New Weapon art for Battle Axes, War Hammers and War Maces.
All Weapons now have art created all the way up to Steel.
All weapons now have the correct Icons. 

Environment:
The Ice Fields no longer deal damage to your armor.
New locations on Freydalyn and Jormungahr 
The concept of dungeons has been implemented in a very minor fashion. Using a soul of a forest giant opens a portal to a dungeon. These dungeons are currently just one room which yields a skull of power. 

Enemies:
Eks now have a chance of dropping Horns.
Plague Wolf Drops have been adjusted. 

 Bug Fixes: 
Fixed the animation sync for other players on hosted servers. You will see what everybody is doing again!
Fixed a crash when saving and loading a player inventory.
"Free" versions of flawless armors have been fixed.
Fixed crashes with Armors, and they now have texture variants.
Forest Giants waking up animations has been fixed.
Enemies losing interest in you after not being able to attack you for a fixed amount of time has been fixed.
Bow textures have been fixed.
Kiilots falling through the world should hopefully be fixed. 

 Known Issues: 
LOD issues with certain objects. 

 Next Up: 
Moving  the Beta branch to the main branch.
Adding and balancing a ton of new items.
More art and design updates to the new world.
Bug fixes.

Weapon attack cooldowns have been adjusted. 
Weapons now have Worn and Flawless Versions. 
Armors now have Worn Versions. 
Worn versions of armor and weapons cannot be crafted and are the only armor and weapon items currently found placed in the world or on enemies.

Furies no longer drop Iron Ore, and instead drop Spirit Shards. 

Trees
Now cut down like resource nodes (take multiple hits to remove chunks) based on weapon tier.

Glaciers in the Ice Shelf can be mined for Ice Chunks. 
When mining rocks you now have a chance to get Whetstone and Clay. 
All Non Rock and Ice Resource Nodes now have a red glow when you are close to them and looking directly at them.

The Ice Shelf is much colder than before.

LOD issues with certain objects.

Bug fixes.

notes.content:
WARNING   This update is only for the Beta. The Beta is currently allowing play on the new islands in Unity 5.3 . Old character saves are not supported in the Beta branch until we update the save system which is slated for an update on 2/11/16 .  Big Changes: 
-	Travel By Portal!
-	Weather Is Back!

  New Features & Patches Notes: 
-	Travel by Portal! The bridge that required the ‘Skull of Lord Kruul’ has now been replaced with a portal system that currently allows fast travel from the first island to the second island. As we work out the kinks with this new interisland travel system, the portal will remain open by default for the week. Keep in mind it’s all placeholder art for now. We welcome any and all feedback you may have with this new approach to island hopping.
-	Weather is Back! This feature has been added into the Beta branch. There are still a few bits of polish to work out (audio and visuals) but please hit up the forums and/or our Trello board and let us know what weather you would like to see affect the Savage Islands in the future.
 -	Several new art updates to inventory icons.
-	Stamina consumption while sprinting has been reduced so you can now sprint further than before.
-	Performance Optimizations. Overall, we are seeing improvements in the ballpark of 10-15 fps. Some of the specifics we looked into this week were culling distances, LOD’s and reflection optimization.
-	Enemy placement has been adjusted across the first two islands.
-	Item Placement has been adjusted across the first two islands.
-	Driftwood piles can now be harvested for logs and sticks. We will be populating the islands with more of these items in the following weeks.
-	Art updates to the islands continues, for the most part this update focused on the second and third island.
-	New first person sprinting animations have been implemented allowing you to see less weapon and hands in your view when sprinting.
-	Tooltips now show on crafting items as well as the Journal.
-	Where am I? Pressing L will now show your location coordinates.

-	Fixed a item disappearing/duplication bug. This occurred when placing items in the action bar from your inventory.
-	Fixed crashes with tabs in the journal, crafting tabs and inventory UI.
-	Fixed several “invisible buildings” issues.
-	Fixed a collision issue in Freydalyn to avoid getting stuck near walls.
-	Fixed a collision issue that prevented players from reliably entering and exiting the updated Wooden House.
-	Gathering resources with axes and hammers now subtract the right amount of durability.

  Known Issues: 
-	Crashes with old characters and old world saves.
-	LOD issues with certain objects. 

 Next Up: 
-	The new “Save System” added.
-	Adding and balancing a ton of new items.
-	More art and design updates to the new world.
-	Bug fixes.

notes.title: Savage Lands Now Available for OSX, Linux and SteamOS
notes.content:
As of today, we are thrilled to add support for Mac OS, Linux and SteamOS platforms!

With the addition of these new platforms, we reach another milestone on our Development Roadmap, and more players can share in the brutality of Savage Lands!

For gamers who have previously played Savage Lands but who now want to move their game to their Mac/Linux/Steam machines, it's easy:

Provided you have not disabled Steam Cloud while previously playing Savage Lands, your gamesaves will be available to you once the game is installed!


Welcome to the Savage Lands, Mac, Linux and SteamOS Players!



Game Update #7 is now LIVE to all players and adds the following functionality:

FIXED:
Plenty of bug fixes (thanks to the community for finding and reporting these!)
Resolved issue with the reading/writing of inventory items (or pickups) which was causing crashes and potentially damaging save files.
Golden Reaver now has correct icon
Stone House should no longer float in air when constructed
Weapon rack in Argo should visually spawn weapons again
Floating props in Argo no longer float 
Repair system changes:
	Items now correctly count down at the first sign of damage 
Items now correctly show how many materials are needed & how many are currently in inventory
Text from "Required Components" to "Broken Components" when in repair. 
Bug that was restoring health to items from old players/worlds.



ADDED:
General:
Mac OS, Linux and Steam OS Support added
New UI element added to make corpse retrieval less frustrating
	When within 200+ meters of your corpse, a crossbones icon will appear on your screen!
Repair system for weapons & armor implemented 
Accessed via new tab under Crafting menu
Repairs can only be made after weapons & armor have 'broken'
New camp added to the north of start location 1
Torch now displays health on icon
Torches should now burnout properly when held or on the ground

Crafting:
Pike of Resurrection animation tuned to shake more slowly upon activation 

Creatures:
Forest Giants now use a new trigger system to spawn
Adjusted day/night skeletons that spawn around the Argo Dragon Tower

Environment:
Two new additional abandoned camps have been added near Argo Dragon Tower 
Giant rocks pillars have been added in the center isle to help make the area more recognizable. 
These rock pillars have been removed from other areas of the island.

Equipment:
Flesh Wrapped Hammer has a new gold texture for metal component
Reckless Edge has been re-textured
Ebon Steel Recipe revamped
Ebon Steel Armor durability increased by 20 for all pieces 
Executioner’s Armor Recipe revamped
Executioner’s Armor durability increased by 10 for all pieces 



Please post bugs here

(Edited 10:19am ~ Kittychix)

notes.title: Savage Lands is AVAILABLE on Steam Early Access!
notes.content:
Signal Studios and DigitalDNA Games are thrilled to release Savage Lands on Steam Early Access today! 

Savage Lands is a first person open world survival game that thrusts players deep into an extensive fantasy world filled with vicious creatures and scarce resources to scavenge for shelter and craft a wide array of unique armor and weapons.


Savage Lands is available right now on Steam Early Access for a special launch week price of $14.99 - 40% off the regular Early Access price of $24.99! 
Grab it now! 


Savage Lands features at launch include:
Huge Open World: Fight for survival across an immense, realistic open world that contains changing time of day, evolving weather conditions, diverse creatures and other surprises scattered around.
Build Your World: Erect shelters for you and your allies to escape hostile creatures and players that roam the island.
Robust Item Crafting: Craft over 50+ unique recipes for armor, weapons, tools and more from the materials scavenged from the land.
Multiplayer: Fight alone or team up with up to 7 other players co-cooperatively to gain resources; open your world to the public or host password protected private games with your friends.

notes.title: Early Access Release Date and Prices Confirmed!
notes.content:
Mark your Calendars for March 5th, 2015 folks - we're releasing to Early Access!
If you missed out on the news during the stream yesterday, we have confirmed our expected date for formal release into Early Access!*


Awesome! Now what about price?
Early Access RELEASE Price: $14.99 (40% off regular Early Access price of $24.99!)

4-packs will also be available, if you want to treat friends and family!
Early Access 4-Pack RELEASE Price: $59.99 (40% off regular Early Access price of $99.99!)

While we've made amazing strides through our month long Alpha process, we know there is a great deal more work to be done, bugs to exterminate and nearly boundless content to be added. Therefore, during Early Access, Savage Lands will be offered at 40% of the regular price!


I have an Alpha copy of Savage Lands - do I need to purchase the game when the Alpha is over?
NO, you do not!

In thanks for helping us test, giving us feedback and generally supporting our crazy new idea, the development team of Signal Studios and Digital DNA Games have decided to give you a FULL copy of the game, with no additional steps necessary on your part.

THANK YOU, from the bottom of our hearts, for helping us reach this next milestone on the Savage Lands journey!



*While we are doing everything possible to meet this target date, there is a slim chance that in the last week of work, something could crop up which would necessitate a delay. IF this is the case, we will clearly communicate this fact as soon as is possible - thanks for your understanding!

notes.title: Alpha Patch Notes #2 - Version 0.1.2 Build 15945
notes.content:
New version is live! Please post all feedback on the new build HERE!!


General Updates: 
Players can now create multiple characters
Players can now save/load worlds in solo and multiplayer
General stability fixes (lots of crash bugs stomped)Players no longer crash when joining hosted game
If a player has any menu open, their character no longer slowly begins to shake until they are shaking rapidly
 Weapons are correctly spawn into the game.
Cooked Deer meat no longer floats in mid-air when player drops it onto the ground
Password protecting a server no longer blocks all players with correct password from joining
All trees can now be chopped down
Cutting down a tree no longer causes it to duplicate
If the player dies when the Cold Meter is completely drained, the meter no longer remains empty on respawn
Frost Fern Bandage now correctly cures bleeding immediately on use 
Day and Night system now correctly syncs always in sync between host and clients.


Art Updates
New terrain textures & normal maps
New texture distribution by altitude range, gets snowier as you are higher
New steepness splat map layer & cliff textures
Corrected global normal map, fixes many terrain lighting issues
Varieties of grass species doubled from 8 to 16
Grass splat map reworked, and is now accommodating all objects placed on map
Daytime direct & ambient light boosted
Rocks lod 1 switch range pushed farther back
Many small fixes & enhancements to the terrain & vegetation
Pass on base texturing underneath villages (more to come) 
Some coarse pathing in/out of village edges (also first pass)
Majority of grasses removed from village sites
Overall tree/bush density increased by 25%
Fixed trees intersecting with rocks 
Boosted snow texture brightness
Fixes to terrain texture normal maps
New textures added to stone houses


Food Updates:
Hunger consumption while sprinting reduced by 30%
Cooked Bear Meat: Grants 40% Stamina, 30% Health, 30% Heat when consumed
Cooked Boar Meat: Grants 14% Stamina, 12% Health, 12% Heat when consumed
Cooked Deer Meat: Grants 18% Stamina, 15% Health, 15% Heat when consumed
Cooked Goat Meat: Grants 10% Stamina, 10% Health, 10% Heat when consumed
Cooked Wolf Meat: Grants 15% Stamina, 15% Health, 18% Heat when consumed


Inventory Updates:
Small pouch Increased lots to 4
Player now starts with a Tattered Sack
Starting items temporarily spawn in player’s inventory (new characters only)
Starting locations items revamped
Drop tables revamped for items that spawn in villages
Leather armor removed from world drop tables and replaced with worn leather armor
Nightbloom Flowers spawners added to the world (localized to just two locations)
New stone texture added to stone houses
Charred skeletons now spawn in the village of Vek
Monolith hides many secrets
